speaker: Doctor

text: I've had this cough for over six months, and it definitely gets worse at night. It also makes me feel quite short of breath when I try to do any physical work. speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms. Spirometry: FEV1 65% of predicted, FVC 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio 0.60 (decreased).

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging and spirometry results strongly suggest an obstructive lung disease, likely COPD. Have you ever been diagnosed with asthma or had a significant history of smoking? Additionally, do you experience wheezing or chest tightness during these episodes?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I have been smoking one pack a day for the past 20 years, and I do have a history of seasonal allergies. I don't feel any chest tightness, but I do hear a whistling sound in my chest when I breathe out hard.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with a history of smoking.
